2024.title: TL;DR Progress at EACL 2024
2024.desc: A multi-faceted interface for literature exploration in text summarization was presented at EACL 2024.

2024.title: Improving argument effectiveness across ideologies
2024.desc: Our work on improving arguments across ideological viewpoints appeared in Findings of EMNLP 2024.

2025.title: Co-organised Lorentz Center workshop
2025.desc: Khalid Al-Khatib co-organised the Lorentz Center workshop Hybrid Argumentation and Responsible AI.

2025.title: QatarDebate Fellowship
2025.desc: Khalid Al-Khatib received the QatarDebate Fellowship in support of current research activity.

2025.title: JTS Early Career Researcher Prize
2025.desc: Recognition from the Jantina Tammes School of Digital Society, Technology and AI.

2025.title: Toward Reasonable Parrots
2025.desc: A position paper on why large language models should argue with us by design was nominated for the best paper award at ArgMining 2025.

2025.title: Cross-lingual Arabic argument mining
2025.desc: Our study of cross-lingual transfer and translation-based approaches to Arabic argument mining appeared at ArabicNLP 2025.

2026.title: Daleel 2026 at ArabicNLP / EMNLP
2026.desc: We co-organised the Daleel shared task with QatarDebate. Twelve teams participated in Arabic argument mining on editorials and debates, and the overview paper is now published.

2026.title: Qing Wang joins the group
2026.desc: Qing Wang joined as a PhD researcher. Her project studies how readers interpret AI in science fiction and how these perspectives can inform AI evaluation.

2026.title: ArgsBase demo at EACL 2026
2026.desc: Our ArgsBase system demonstration paper appeared at EACL 2026. It describes a multi-agent interface for structured human–AI deliberation.

2026.title: ARGUS preprint on narratives and persuasion
2026.desc: Sara Nabhani and collaborators released ARGUS, a study of how narrative features relate to persuasion in online arguments.

2026.title: Shonan Seminar on argumentation and recommender systems
2026.desc: Khalid Al-Khatib attended NII Shonan Meeting No.239 and gave a talk on hybrid argumentation and recommendation systems.
